title: Vatluri va Ntwanano lava nga evuhlongeni
intro: Emasikwini yo sungula ya vaaki lava ha ku sungulaka, rixaka rin’wana ri tshame ri tshama etindlwini leti tiyisiweke, ri bohiwile hi ntwanano. Loko ntwanano wolowo wu xengiwa, vuyelo bya kona byi twala emaphepheni ya Quran. Xana vanhu lava a ku ri vamani, naswona ku ve yini hi makaya ya vona ni masimu ya vona ya mihandzu?
clues: A hi tshama etindhawini leti tiyeke leti hi nyikeke ku titwa ka mavunwa ka nsirhelelo.
A hi ri vanhu va Matsalwa, hambiswiritano hi tlule ntwanano wa hina.
Hi endle rhengu ro lwisana ni murhumiwa loyi endzhaku ka loko a tile eka hina, kambe rhengu ra hina ri tsandzekile.
Mirhi ya hina ya ncindzu yi tsemiwile hi xileriso xa Allah, xikombiso xa matimba ya Yena.
Hi hlongoriwile emakaya ya hina, hi nga ha vuyi, tanihi nxupulo wa ku kaneta ka hina.
Quran yi hi boxa eka ndzima ya nhlengeletano, naswona xitori xa hina xi tirha tanihi xilemukiso eka lava va tlulaka mintwanano.

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku rhendzeriwa ni ku hlongoriwa emakaya ya vona
trial.answer: Ku rhendzeriwa ni ku hlongoriwa emakaya ya vona

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Va hlongoriwile na nhundzu ya vona yi tekiwile
U nghene eparadeyisini hi ku hatlisa
outcome.answer: Va hlongoriwile na nhundzu ya vona yi tekiwile

arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
